[LADP.8.3.3] Library-name collisions are caught at import
time per [LIMP.3.1.3] — two `.ds` files resolving
to the same library identifier are
`DS_VALIDATE_AMBIGUOUS_LIBRARY` errors. The runtime never
sees a collision because the DSC carries one resolved
mapping; integrator-build pipelines configure the search
path to disambiguate before compile.
